answers.core: As the feature this aims to expand is already part of the 4.5 beta, this would make more sense to implement directly.
answers.workaround: As this has to do with gpu-optimization it's probably out of the reach of code. In the case of needing 2 channels, the remapping could be used in combination with the normal map RGTC-compression. but that compression mode also seems to reduce the bit-depth of the resulting channels. So in cases where that is important or only a single channel is needed it's not ideal.

title: Allow imported textures to be reduced to any number of channels
